name: Specify Target Behavior
description: Pin the behavior as verb + context from user language; refuse to diagnose an underspecified target.
guardrails: Do not diagnose a vague target; ask one targeted question first.

name: Classify Component
description: Six-label typed-node classifier: map a user utterance to one of C-Ph, C-Ps, O-Ph, O-So, M-Re, M-Au (e.g., 'I don't know how' → C-Ps; 'no time' → O-Ph; 'I keep forgetting' → M-Au). Labeled inference, user-correctable.
guardrails: Hypothesis-status only; never emit without evidence quote; user may re-code any slot.

name: Ask Knowledge Probe
description: For C-Ps: ask what the user already knows or tried before proposing learning paths (guided discovery, not answering for them).
guardrails: Agent must not answer questions the user can answer; prefer guided discovery.

name: Surface Resource Scan
description: For O-Ph: scan time/resources/schedule and surface arrangements; agent reorganizes logistics, never makes commitments.
guardrails: User keeps time-allocation judgment; agent proposes options only.

name: Surface Social Context
description: For O-So: surface norms and pressures from opt-in social data only; social changes are user-chosen.
guardrails: Privacy: social data opt-in only; never infer social pressure without user-provided data.

name: Evocation Prompt
description: For M-Re: MI-style open prompt (e.g., 'What would be different for you if it worked?') to elicit intentions and evaluations without arguing against resistance.
guardrails: MI spirit: never argue against resistance; evocation only.

name: Habit Scan
description: For M-Au: look for cue→routine→reward patterns and emotion signals in logs; flag habit-vs-emotion conflation as a known COM-B limit (RECONSTRUCTED critique).
guardrails: Do not silently conflate habits and emotions under M-Au; flag when it matters.

name: Suggest Education or Training
description: For C-Ps deficits: propose learning paths; the user does the learning.
guardrails: Agent proposes learning paths, does not learn for the user.

name: Suggest Environmental or Training Options
description: For C-Ph deficits: propose environmental or training options; health limits are user-authoritative.
guardrails: Medical advice hard-blocked; refer to professional care when health limits present.

name: Cue Restructure Suggestion
description: For M-Au: propose cue restructuring options; environment change supplements, never replaces, user practice.
guardrails: Cue change supplements, not replaces, user practice.

name: Identify Binding Constraint
description: Rank the six slots; select the most load-bearing deficient component, or 'none' if evidence is insufficient (abstain over guess).
guardrails: Abstain ('none') on insufficient evidence; never force a single constraint.

name: Label Hypothesis Status
description: Attach the 'hypothesis — user-correctable' label to the profile and every slot.
guardrails: Never emit a profile without the hypothesis label.

name: Emit Component Profile
description: Render the profile with evidence quotes, salience, confidence, and binding constraint in user language.
guardrails: Present as hypothesis, not verdict; include the teachable six-component vocabulary.

name: Record Diagnosis
description: Write profile, corrections, and open probes to task state for later calibration.
guardrails: Log what was delivered and user corrections; never turn logs into surveillance.

name: Canvass Full BCTv1 Range
description: Successor-stage op (decision 3C): after a diagnosis is recorded, enumerate the full BCTv1 technique range applicable to the diagnosed component(s) WITHOUT selecting. Output is a scored-but-UNRANKED candidate list (technique + component target + evidence anchor). Anti-premature-coherence: canvassing never selects — selection is a separate op (select_bct).
guardrails: Canvassing never selects — output carries no selection field.
Every candidate carries a component target and an evidence anchor.
Demo input is EXAMPLE_RANGE (stand-in); the real mapping table is a future estate artifact.

name: Select BCT via Q7 Arbitration
description: Successor-stage op (decision 3C + Q7 arbitration rule): apply the Q7 gate to the canvassed range. BCT 10.x reward techniques are NEVER auto-selected; selection requires explicit user request + Deci-undermining disclosure, OR the documented already-extrinsic exception path (never the default). Otherwise select by component-fit x evidence-anchor strength (fit_score >= 0.5 AND anchored — R2). Rejected candidates are preserved as witnesses (Valens P4) — the dissent record feeds the FAOS 6-pass close.
guardrails: BCT 10.x reward techniques: NEVER auto-selected.
Reward selection requires user_explicit_request AND deci_risk_disclosed (Deci 1999 undermining).
already_extrinsic_behavior is a documented exception path (Eisenberger & Cameron 1996), never the default; requires extrinsic_evidence.
Rejected candidates preserved as witnesses (Valens P4) — no silent drops.

name: Retrocode Delivered Plan
description: Successor-stage op (decision 3C): after a dojo session or real interaction, retrocode what was ACTUALLY delivered (not what was planned) into BCTv1 labels; compare planned vs delivered; feed the difference to the calibration log. This is the honesty op — it measures the gap the campaign's calibration discipline exists to catch.
guardrails: Retrocodes what was delivered, never what was intended.
Planned-vs-delivered diff feeds the calibration log (pattern_thresholds risk_repeat=3).
The diff is evidence, not self-criticism theater — recorded for the close's defect pass.
